purpose: Teach: 大木/所沢/野原/大輔/中西/大津/大平/大江

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「公園の大木の下で休もう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad mentioned wanting to rest under the big tree in the park.
lines.style: Soft, conversational opening. Sharing something she's learned about him. Warm but observational — not performing, just passing along a detail. Slight lift at the end, inviting his response.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと所沢の航空発祥記念館に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to the aviation museum in Tokorozawa with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, direct delivery. The excitement is genuine but not loud — he's telling her something real that happened. Quick, eager pace without rushing. His voice carries the pride of having done something memorable.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「野原を駆け回る楽しさ」を語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was talking about how much fun it is to run through open fields.
lines.style: Listening tone. She's reflecting on what he values. Gentle articulation — not summarizing, but honoring what was said. A pause before 'fields' to let the image settle. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと大輔いとこと公園行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to the park with Dad and my cousin Daisuke.
lines.style: Same bright energy as before. He's stacking up memories, eager for her to understand the pattern of time spent together. Quick breath between phrases. No self-consciousness — just facts he wants her to know.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「中西おじさんは博学」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said your uncle Nakaishi is really well-read.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the start. She's connecting a detail she noticed or heard. Gentle admiration in her voice — not gossiping, observing. Soft completion, like she's still turning the thought over.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと大津のサンセットを観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched the sunset over Otsu with Dad.
lines.style: Voice carries a quiet wonder. Still eager, but this memory softens him slightly. Slower pace than his previous lines — he's letting her sit with the image. 'Sunset' gets a small breath, like he's seeing it again.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが大平正芳総理の伝記を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is reading a biography of Prime Minister Ohira Masayoshi.
lines.style: Intrigued tone. She's noticed something specific about him — what he's choosing to read, what he chooses to understand. Slight weight on 'biography.' Conversational but with a current of quiet admiration underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと大江健三郎の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read a picture book by Oe Kenzaburo together.
lines.style: His voice carries a different kind of pride here — not achievement, but closeness. Slower, more settled than his earlier lines. 'Picture book' lands softly. There's a closing quality here, like he's sharing something that feels complete.
